title: HR Manager
description:
Key Responsibilities Manager HR & Administration 
 Develop and implement HR strategy and workforce planning aligned with business goals and budgets. Partner with business leaders on manpower planning, organisational capability and employee-related issues . Manage end-to-end recruitment and talent acquisition for India and overseas manpower requirements. Build and maintain talent pools for plant, Indian and overseas requirements. Handle overseas manpower deployment , including visa, offer, transportation and employment coordination. Manage complete employee lifecycle – onboarding, development, retention and separation. Drive employee engagement, communication and grievance handling . Identify training needs and coordinate employee training and capability development . Manage HR and Administration processes for both on-roll and contractual employees. Plan and monitor administration budgets, facilities and service delivery . Ensure statutory, HR, safety and quality compliance and coordinate internal/external audits. Handle employee relations and liaison activities with relevant stakeholders. Lead HR process improvement and technology implementation initiatives. Prepare HR MIS, reports and management inputs for decision-making. Coordinate with BHR, CHR and plant leadership on HR projects and organisational initiatives . Monitor HR KPIs such as manpower productivity, recruitment TAT, training compliance, grievances and employee satisfaction . Drive continuous improvement, process automation and HR digitalisation initiatives.

Key Skills: HR Operations,Grievance Handling,Plant HR,Employee Relations,Talent Acquisition,Acquisition,Hrsd,Management
